name: dialog
useFor: Use for a short task that must be finished or dismissed before going back to the page (create a site, name an export). Put the fields in DialogBody and the main action last. DialogBody fades at an edge (fade-y) where more content scrolls past it.
constraints: A dialog for a destructive confirmation (use Alert Dialog)
